description: Replays a saved multi-step journey (e.g. "add to cart -> checkout") against its registered site and checkpoints accessibility at each step. Pro+ (JOURNEYS; also AUTHENTICATED_SCANS when the journey logs in). Steps and any login credential always come from the journey's own saved configuration — never accepted here. Saved click or fill steps can submit forms or trigger external actions, so run only a journey the user has reviewed. Queues the run and returns immediately with a runId — call get_journey_run to poll.

journeyName.description: The saved journey's name, as configured in the app.

siteHost.description: The registered site's normalized host, as list_sites reports it.

name: run_journey

coverageDisclaimer.description: Why this result is not a compliance verdict. Always relay it; never present a scan as proof of conformance.

scoringGuidance.description: Binding instruction for the assistant reading this result. Follow it literally.

standard.description: The standard the checks were run against, e.g. "WCAG 2.1 AA".

title: Run a saved user journey
